_note: The hell's puzzle pieces (src/world_kit/hell_puzzles.gd, docs/HOELLE-RAETSEL.de.md). reach = px within which a piece is used with E (pipes: pipe_reach). burn: what a hot cell does (hits = hits of the depth's dmg, back to the room's rune). vent: beat = s per beat of the Flammentakt, period = beats of a wave (a vent fires on beat 0 and glows on the last). flood: cycle s of one ebb-warn-flood round, ebb and warn = s from its start where they end. eye: beat = s per beat, open / closed = beats an eye stays open / shut (pieces may set their own). thorns: hits one thorn heart costs (hits x dmg LP, never below 1 LP). flow: s the lava stays in the pipes after a failed sluice. look: colours of the drawn pieces (hex).
